verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB documents point-in-time recovery that rolls back "to any moment" so an accidental drop is a quick cleanup. Its feature-status page describes time travel as restoring the database to an earlier point, alongside automated daily backups and a defined recovery model. This covers the restore half of the story. Nothing shows querying data as of a past point without restoring, and recovery is described at database level rather than per table. missing for 10: query-as-of-past-timestamp capability, table-level restore granularity, detailed recovery-window/retention docs, independent or hands-on corroboration
